Maya: Heads-up — Valor Platform flagged a billing problem on invoice INV-2026-0427. Looks like a promo credit was applied twice during the pricing experiment; partner was credited $4,500 but expected $2,250. Can we do a manual rectification + goodwill note? @Trevor
Trevor: Can you paste the invoice lines and how the credits were applied? need numbers to approve a manual adjustment.
Maya: Sure — copying relevant lines below:
```
Invoice: INV-2026-0427
Line 1: Usage - gen-api - $9,000
Line 2: Promo SPRING24 credit -$2,250
Line 3: manual_goodwill credit -$2,250
Total after credits: $4,500 (should be $6,750 -> credit only once)
```
billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-0427 posted 2026-04-27T17:12:03Z. Credits applied: promo:SPRING24 -$2,250; manual_goodwill -$2,250.
Olivia: Looks like the manual_goodwill got applied automatically by the pricing-experiment webhook twice for this partner. We should issue a reversing adjustment for one of the credits. Options: (1) refund $2,250 to payment method, (2) apply $2,250 account credit and send CN. Logan, partner preference?
Logan: Partner prefers account credit over refund so they can use it against next month. Also asked for a short apology note.
Trevor: I approve issuing a credit note CN-2026-0765 for $2,250 to correct the double-credit and mark it as goodwill. @Maya please route to AP and include the partner note. :thumbsup:
Maya: Got it. I'll create the reversing journal and the credit note, tag it as goodwill, and notify AP. I'll also open a ticket for eng-runtime to investigate the experiment webhook dedupe; we shouldn't be auto-applying manual_goodwill.
Maya: Creating CN-2026-0765 now and routing to AP (ticket FIN-8421). Will update once posted.
billing-bot: Adjustment CN-2026-0765 queued for posting. Estimated posting: 24 hours.
Maya: Done — credit applied as account credit and partner notified with the apology note. Closing loop. :white_check_mark:
